messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync on tri-mode landing copy. Objective: make Hosted feel fastest-to-start, Dedicated feel production-ready, Private feel compliance-first. Need short hero lines, a crisp benchmark blurb, webinar signup copy, and inbound routing.
Diego (Growth): Agree. Prioritize hero clarity, benchmark, then CTA variants (webinar vs demo).
Priya (Content): Draft hero microcopy (keep 6-9 words): Hosted: 'Single API to start building 9 instant results.' Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity for predictable production throughput.' Private: 'Deploy in your VPC 9 full control and auditability.'
Sam (Demand Gen): Webinar form: two tracks 9 Self-serve -> send recording + onboarding checklist; Enterprise -> AE follow-up.
Jordan (Sales Ops): Routing sketch for engineers: incoming /signup with product_mode field. Map hosted -> inbound_hosted queue, dedicated -> dedicated_sales, private -> enterprise_ops. Add hidden 'benchmark_interest=true' when benchmark CTA used. Auto-assign companies >1000 employees to AE queue.
Ava (Marketing): Benchmark line options: we have P95 90ms on Hosted (short prompts) and ~40% lower per-token cost with Optimize batching. Candidate: 'Real-world P95 90ms 3 40% lower per-token cost.'
Diego (Growth): Tighten to 'Real-world P95 90ms 3 40% lower per-token cost' (middle dot).
Priya (Content): Webinar microcopy: 'Join our workshop: live benchmarks, migration checklist, and an engineering Q&A.' CTA options: 'Save my spot', 'Request enterprise walkthrough', 'Watch on demand'.
Sam (Demand Gen): A/B test two hero variants: A) benchmark-first hero + webinar CTA, B) product-first hero + start button. Hypothesis: benchmark-first increases qualified platform signups. I'll own experiment and tracking params (utm_campaign=tri-copy-pilot&utm_variant=bench-hero).
Jordan (Sales Ops): I'll implement SF routing rules and notify templates. Include queue logic and priority flags.
Priya (Content): Drafts pushed to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-copy-pilot.
Ava (Marketing): Action items: Priya finalize copy today; Diego set up A/B; Sam wire tracking; Jordan implement SF rules. Copy review 3pm — drop comments on Drive if you can't make it.
lifecycle-bot: New benchmark uploaded: hosted-short-prompts-v2 at /benchmarks/hosted-short-prompts-v2. Pinged @Ava @Diego.
Diego (Growth): Will use that for variant A.
Sam (Demand Gen): I'll prepare webinar gating flow and segments.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after review and finalize wire for launch.
